label: Entertainment
definition: Narrative-first content meant to amuse, engage, or emotionally hook. Includes skits, dramas, pop culture, celebrity content.

label: Movies & TV
definition: Narrative content about scripted entertainment — includes reviews, recaps, breakdowns, and lore analysis.

label: Film
definition: Films and filmmaking from the audience side: critique, analysis, and discussion of story, craft, and cultural impact.
scope_note: Excludes television series (01.01.002) and nature or space storytelling (13.41.083).

label: Blockbuster Films
definition: Covers major studio films, franchises, and tentpole releases, including their story, spectacle, and cultural impact.

label: Independent Film
definition: Covers independent and arthouse cinema, including its narrative themes and artistic style.

label: Television
definition: Scripted television series: episodes, arcs, characters, and the conversation around them.
scope_note: Excludes film (01.01.001).

label: Currently Airing Series
definition: Covers scripted series during their broadcast run, followed episode by episode as new installments release.

label: Season Arcs & Finales
definition: Highlights seasonal arcs or finales with emphasis on narrative payoff or fan impact.

label: Comedy
definition: Humor-forward content designed to entertain through skits, satire, parody, improv, or stand-up.

label: Sketch & Improv Comedy
definition: Scripted sketches and improvised scenes performed for laughs.
scope_note: Excludes pretend play made for kids (01.67.161). Parody of a specific genre keeps that genre's path with Format 67 Parody.

label: Scripted Sketches
definition: Covers scripted comedy sketches written and performed as self-contained scenes.

label: Improv Scenes
definition: Improvised comedy content featuring spontaneous dialogue and unpredictable scenarios.

label: Stand-Up
definition: Solo comedic performances delivered to a live or virtual audience, often observational or narrative in tone.

label: Club & Open Mic Sets
definition: Covers stand-up sets performed at comedy clubs, open mics, and touring shows outside of produced specials.

label: Comedy Specials
definition: Long-form recorded comedy specials with structured pacing and audience engagement.

label: Music & Performance
definition: Live or recorded expression through music, dance, acting, or talent-based performance.

label: Music Releases
definition: Recorded music and its visual releases: singles, music videos, and independent audio-visual work.
scope_note: Excludes how music is written or produced (06.18) and live concerts (01.03.006).

label: Pop Releases
definition: Showcases professionally released music content for mainstream distribution.

label: Indie & Experimental Music
definition: Highlights independently produced music videos or audio-visual experiments.

label: Concerts & Stage Performance
definition: Music, theater, dance, or busking performed before an audience, at venues or in public spaces.
scope_note: Excludes kids' songs (01.67.159) and worship services (16.51.113).

label: Concerts & Festivals
definition: Covers concerts, music festivals, and ticketed live music events.

label: Street Shows
definition: Street-level performances including dance, theater, or busking recorded in public spaces.

label: Kids & Family
definition: Genres made for children that have no adult equivalent: kids' songs, toy play, and kids' animation.
scope_note: Excludes children's versions of other subjects, such as early learning (02.04.160), science, gaming, and crafts, which take that subject's path with made_for_kids = TRUE, and family vlogs made for adults (10.29.059).

label: Nursery Rhymes & Kids' Songs
definition: Songs, rhymes, and music made for young children, usually animated or performed for sing-along.

label: Nursery Rhymes & Sing-Alongs
definition: Classic and original nursery rhymes and sing-along songs.

label: Dance & Movement Songs
definition: Songs built around dancing, actions, and movement for kids.

label: Preschool Learning
definition: Early-learning content teaching letters, numbers, colors, shapes, and first words.

label: ABCs & Counting
definition: Alphabet, phonics, and counting lessons for preschoolers.

label: Colors, Shapes & First Words
definition: Early vocabulary, colors, and shapes taught through repetition and play.

label: Toy Play & Unboxing
definition: Toys opened, played with, and used to tell stories, made for a child audience.

label: New Toys & Collectibles
definition: Covers newly released toys, playsets, and surprise collectibles presented for a child audience.

label: Pretend Play & Toy Stories
definition: Stories acted out with toys, dolls, and playsets.

label: Kids' Animation & Characters
definition: Animated series, recurring characters, and story content made for children.

label: Animated Kids' Series
definition: Episodic animated shows and character channels for children.

label: Picture Books & Bedtime Stories
definition: Covers picture books, fairy tales, and bedtime stories for young children.

label: Competitions & Spectacle
definition: Large-scale creator competitions, stunts, and giveaway spectacles built around stakes and elimination.
scope_note: Use when the competition or stunt itself is the subject. A challenge about another topic (cooking, fitness) keeps that topic's path, with Format 07 Challenge where that Sub-Niche lists it (Rule 6.10).

label: Creator Competitions
definition: Contests among participants for a prize: last-to-leave games, elimination games, and team challenges.

label: Elimination Games
definition: Participants are knocked out round by round until one wins the prize.

label: Endurance Contests
definition: Last-to-leave and how-long-can-you-last contests where the prize goes to whoever holds out.

label: Stunts & Giveaways
definition: Large-budget stunts, builds, and giveaways staged for spectacle.

label: Extreme Stunts
definition: Dangerous, extreme, or record-setting stunts and builds performed for an audience.

label: Giveaway & Philanthropy Spectacles
definition: Large giveaways and staged acts of generosity built as entertainment.

label: Education
definition: Purpose is to teach, explain, or transfer skills. Includes tutorials, explainers, language learning, academic breakdowns.
scope_note: Excludes nursery rhymes and kids' songs (01.67.159). Early learning for young children stays here (02.04.160) with made_for_kids = TRUE.

label: Academic
definition: Formal subject matter rooted in school or university disciplines — often structured and instructional.

label: Math Lessons
definition: Teaches math concepts or problem-solving using clear, step-by-step visual instruction.

label: Algebra
definition: Covers algebraic concepts and problem-solving, from equations and variables to functions.

label: Calculus
definition: Covers calculus principles such as limits, derivatives, and integrals.

label: History Lessons
definition: Explains historical events, timelines, figures, or cultural eras through narrative or analysis.
scope_note: Excludes military history (05.15.104) and historical conspiracies (05.15.091).

label: Ancient Civilizations
definition: Covers ancient civilizations, from early societies through late antiquity, through artifacts and analysis.

label: Modern History
definition: Covers twentieth- and twenty-first-century history and its impact on contemporary society.

label: Skills & DIY
definition: Instructional content teaching practical, hands-on tasks like repairs, crafts, or creative builds.

label: Coding & Programming
definition: Learning to code: building, testing, and deploying software, taught step by step.
scope_note: Education when the primary intent is teaching a learner step by step. Excludes content about the technology itself for practitioners: demos, debugging, best practices (04.11).

label: Web Development
definition: Teaches how to build websites through HTML, CSS, and JavaScript foundations.

label: App Coding
definition: Teaches beginners to build their first mobile apps, step by step from design to deployment.

label: Handcrafts
definition: Making objects and handmade goods by hand, taught step by step, such as woodworking and sewing.
scope_note: Step-by-step instruction for learners. Excludes the maker's process, finished work, and craft culture (06.45).

label: Woodworking
definition: Walks through hands-on woodworking projects from materials to finishing techniques.

label: Sewing
definition: Covers sewing construction, stitching techniques, and fabric selection for garments and household items.

label: Science & Discovery
definition: Content exploring physical, natural, or theoretical phenomena with curiosity and explanation.
scope_note: Classroom-style science teaching for learners. Excludes research, discoveries, and science news (Sector 13).

label: Space Exploration
definition: Explores human and robotic exploration of space, astronomy, or rocketry.

label: Planets & Moons
definition: Covers the planets, moons, and other bodies of the solar system and beyond.

label: Space Missions
definition: Covers technical details of crewed and robotic space missions, launches, and landings.

label: Nature Studies
definition: Educational content on ecosystems, wildlife, and earth’s natural environments.

label: Wildlife Behavior
definition: Analyzes animal behavior, instincts, and interactions in their natural environments.

label: Ecosystems & Habitats
definition: Covers ecosystems and habitats, including their species, terrain, climate, and environmental balance.

label: Language Learning
definition: Learning, teaching, and living in other languages, from structured lessons to immersion and culture.

label: Language Lessons
definition: Structured instruction in a language, from first words to grammar and vocabulary.

label: Essential Phrases
definition: Covers greetings, introductions, and everyday core phrases for new learners.

label: Grammar & Vocabulary
definition: Targeted lessons on grammar rules, word lists, and common mistakes.

label: Language Learning Journeys
definition: Documenting the process of learning a language, including challenges, progress, and immersion.

label: Self-Taught Learning
definition: Covers learners teaching themselves a language on a set timeline, from first lessons to fluency milestones.

label: Immersion & Polyglot Life
definition: Living in or switching between languages, often with native-speaker conversations.

label: Language & Culture
definition: Slang, idioms, accents, and the cultural context behind how a language is spoken.

label: Slang & Idioms
definition: Everyday expressions, slang, and idioms native speakers actually use.

label: Accent & Pronunciation
definition: Pronunciation coaching, accent comparisons, and accent challenges.

label: Lifestyle
definition: Personal identity content: routines, fashion, food, home, beauty. Often vlog-style or advice-driven.

label: Fitness
definition: Exercise for general health, strength, and appearance: workouts, programs, and form for non-competitive training.
scope_note: Excludes training to compete in a sport (11.34) and nutrition, sleep, and recovery (09.26).

label: Yoga
definition: Guided practices or routines designed to improve flexibility, balance, or breath control.

label: Beginner Yoga
definition: Covers introductory yoga movements, breathing, and alignment for new practitioners.

label: Advanced Yoga
definition: Covers advanced yoga sequences, inversions, arm balances, and strength-based flexibility work.

label: Strength Training
definition: Training routines designed to increase muscular strength, endurance, and performance.

label: Weightlifting
definition: Demonstrates proper form and techniques in free weights and gym-based strength routines.

label: Bodyweight Exercises
definition: Shows no-equipment exercises emphasizing core strength, mobility, and repetition sets.

label: Strength Programs
definition: Structured multi-week strength programs built on progressive overload, as opposed to single-lift form and technique.

label: Cardio & Conditioning
definition: Cardio, HIIT, and follow-along workouts for endurance and general fitness.

label: Endurance Cardio
definition: Covers running, cycling, rowing, and other aerobic training for endurance and heart health.

label: Home HIIT & Conditioning
definition: Covers high-intensity and conditioning workouts done at home with little or no equipment.

label: Food & Cooking
definition: Content showcasing food prep, recipes, taste tests, cooking tips, and culinary storytelling.

label: Dishes & Meals
definition: What people cook: specific dishes, cuisines, diets, and meal types.
scope_note: Excludes diet plans built around health goals (09.26.052) and allergen-free cooking (09.49.092).

label: Vegan Dishes
definition: Prepares plant-based meals using accessible ingredients and clean presentation.

label: Quick Meals
definition: Demonstrates meals that can be prepared in 30 minutes or less for time-conscious audiences.

label: Cooking Techniques
definition: Techniques, methods, or principles used to prepare food or refine cooking skills.

label: Baking
definition: Covers baking techniques including dough preparation, timing, decoration, and ingredient handling.

label: Grilling & BBQ
definition: Offers instruction or techniques for grilling meat, vegetables, or specialty items over open flame or heat.

label: Grocery Shopping
definition: Walks through shopping routines, product selection, or budgeting in grocery settings.

label: Household Essentials
definition: Covers shopping for cleaning products, paper goods, and other non-food household staples on grocery runs.

label: Ready-Made Food
definition: Food bought rather than cooked at home: fast food, restaurant meals, and packaged products, tried and judged on taste.
scope_note: Excludes restaurant and food travel guides (14.42.086).

label: Fast Food
definition: Covers fast-food chains and their menus, including oversized, secret, and novelty items.

label: Restaurants & Packaged Foods
definition: Covers restaurants, menu items, and packaged grocery foods tried and judged on taste.

label: Fashion & Beauty
definition: Aesthetic-focused content including makeup tutorials, hauls, styling, skincare, and reviews.

label: Makeup
definition: Makeup application, techniques, products, and transformations.
scope_note: Excludes skincare (03.09.134) and cosmetic procedures (09.49.100).

label: Everyday Makeup
definition: Covers natural, everyday makeup looks for work, school, and daily wear.

label: SFX & Fantasy Makeup
definition: Covers dramatic, fantasy, and special effects makeup using prosthetics, body paint, and FX products.

label: Fashion Trends
definition: Content about seasonal, cultural, or community trends in personal style or appearance.

label: Streetwear
definition: Covers urban fashion trends rooted in youth culture, sneakers, skatewear, or music scenes.

label: High Fashion
definition: Showcases couture, editorial, and designer fashion with a focus on artistic presentation and runway aesthetics.

label: Skincare
definition: Skin health and appearance: routines, products, ingredients, and treatments for specific concerns.
scope_note: Excludes clinical treatments such as Botox or filler (09.49.100) and makeup (03.09.017).

label: Skin Types & Regimens
definition: Covers building morning and night skincare regimens for different skin types.

label: Skincare Products & Dupes
definition: Covers skincare products and brands, including cheaper alternatives to popular items.

label: Ingredient Science
definition: What active ingredients do, how to combine them, and what the evidence says.

label: Skin Concerns
definition: Acne, aging, hyperpigmentation, and other concerns, including treatment journeys.

label: Home & Garden
definition: Functional or aesthetic content about living spaces — cleaning, decor, plants, repairs.

label: Beekeeping
definition: Teaches beekeeping basics, hive care, and honey harvesting techniques.

label: Hive Management
definition: Demonstrates beekeeping techniques including hive health, harvesting, and safety.

label: Home Renovation
definition: Guides home improvement, interior updates, or repair and renovation tutorials.
scope_note: Renovating a home to live in. Excludes flipping homes for profit (08.62.148).

label: Room Renovations
definition: Covers do-it-yourself renovation of individual rooms such as kitchens, bathrooms, and bedrooms.

label: Household Appliances
definition: Appliances and gadgets for running a home, such as vacuums, air fryers, and cleaning tools, judged on daily household use.
scope_note: Excludes connected and smart-home devices (04.10.020).

label: Kitchen & Cleaning Appliances
definition: Covers kitchen and cleaning appliances such as air fryers, blenders, vacuums, and mops, judged on daily use.

label: Personal Celebrations
definition: Content that shares or stages milestone moments like weddings, birthdays, or reveals.
scope_note: Excludes dating and relationship advice (03.61).

label: Weddings & Milestones
definition: Planning, staging, and sharing weddings, birthdays, reveals, and other milestone events.

label: Marriage Ceremonies
definition: Shares wedding rituals, planning, and cultural variations.

label: Hobbies & Collecting
definition: Hobby practice and collecting: sourcing, grading, displaying, and trading collectibles.

label: Comic Book Collecting
definition: Discusses how to collect, grade, or organize comic books and related memorabilia.
scope_note: Comics as objects to collect, grade, and trade. Excludes comic stories and characters (06.48.099).

label: Comic Grading & Valuation
definition: Covers grading, preserving, and valuing comic books and related merchandise.

label: Relationships & Dating
definition: Dating, relationships, and singlehood, from advice and stories to couples content.
scope_note: Excludes weddings and milestone events (03.50) and family life (10.29.059).

label: Dating
definition: Meeting people and early-stage dating, including apps, first dates, and dating culture.

label: Flirting & Attraction
definition: Covers meeting people, flirting, texting, and reading romantic signals.

label: Personal Dating Life
definition: Covers creators' own dating lives, including first dates, mishaps, and ongoing updates.

label: Dating App Culture
definition: Dating apps, profiles, and the culture around online dating.

label: Relationships & Couples
definition: Committed relationships, from couples content to advice on making them work.

label: Couple Life
definition: Covers couples' everyday life together, including shared routines, milestones, and relationship dynamics.

label: Relationship Health
definition: Covers communication, conflict resolution, and keeping long-term relationships healthy.

label: Breakups & Singlehood
definition: Ending relationships, recovering from them, and being single.

label: Breakup Recovery
definition: Getting over a breakup, including personal stories and advice.

label: Technology
definition: Covers tools, software, hardware, AI, reviews, product demos. Can be consumer or technical in scope.

label: Consumer Tech
definition: Reviews and usage of personal tech products like phones, gadgets, and wearables.

label: Personal Gadgets
definition: Personal tech products such as phones, laptops, headphones, and wearables.

label: Smartphones
definition: Reviews or compares phone models, features, or accessories with a focus on consumer usability.

label: Wearables
definition: Explores fitness trackers, smartwatches, and AR devices through demonstrations or performance tests.

label: Smart Devices
definition: Connected and smart-enabled devices, including smart-home hubs, automation, and IoT gadgets: setup, ecosystems, and how the technology works.
scope_note: Excludes non-connected household appliances (03.47.103).

label: Home Automation
definition: Demonstrates or reviews smart home systems like lighting, thermostats, or voice-controlled hubs.

label: IoT Gadgets
definition: Explains interconnected smart devices and their functionality in home, work, or lifestyle applications.

label: Software & Coding
definition: Instructional or exploratory content focused on programming, debugging, and digital tools.
scope_note: Content about software and code for practitioners. Excludes beginner coding lessons (02.05.009).

label: App Development
definition: Demonstrations or walkthroughs of building or deploying software applications.

label: iOS & Android Development
definition: Covers building and deploying native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.

label: Desktop App Development
definition: Covers building and deploying desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

label: Programming Skills
definition: Conceptual or instructional content on writing, structuring, or improving code logic.

label: Code Debugging
definition: Walks through identifying and fixing errors in software, often using real-time screen capture or examples.

label: Clean Code & Conventions
definition: Covers professional coding habits, conventions, and code quality practices.

label: Digital Culture
definition: Content that documents, reflects, or participates in platform-native trends, memes, or subcultures.

label: Internet Trends
definition: Highlights or commentary on current viral moments, internet behavior, and digital culture.

label: Social Media Shifts
definition: Analyzes updates, platform policy changes, or user behavior trends shaping social ecosystems.

label: Meme Culture
definition: Explores viral formats, remix behavior, or visual language emerging from internet humor.

label: Digital Media
definition: Making, growing, and monetizing content on digital platforms.

label: Video Creation
definition: Creating, structuring, and growing video-first content across platforms.

label: Podcasting
definition: Hosting, editing, growing, and monetizing a podcast.

label: Emerging Tech
definition: Content featuring experimental or high-growth technologies like AI, blockchain, and VR/AR.

label: AI Applications
definition: Demonstrations or explanations of how AI models or tools are used in real scenarios.

label: Chatbots
definition: Demonstrates how chatbots are built, trained, and used in customer service, content, or automation workflows.

label: Machine Learning
definition: Explains how ML models are structured, trained, and applied across tasks like prediction, classification, or personalization.

label: AI Tools & Productivity
definition: Demos and reviews of consumer AI tools for work, study, and creative tasks.

label: Blockchain Tech
definition: Explains blockchain technology, decentralization, crypto, or smart contracts.
scope_note: How blockchains and smart contracts work. Excludes trading and crypto markets (08.22.045).

label: Crypto Protocols & Technology
definition: Breaks down how digital currencies and protocols function, and the risks or innovations they bring.

label: Smart Contracts
definition: Explains how blockchain-based contracts execute automatically, often using real-world examples or project walkthroughs.

label: News & Commentary
definition: Discusses current events, politics, cultural takes. Includes both factual updates and subjective analysis.

label: Current Events
definition: Real-time or recent commentary on news, culture, or global developments.

label: Breaking News
definition: Real-time or same-day coverage of breaking stories, emergencies, or global events.
scope_note: Excludes ongoing war coverage (05.15.104). Tragedies involving real victims add 17.52.123 to sensitive_topics.

label: Developing Stories
definition: Stories still unfolding, such as emergencies, disasters, or fast-moving events, with information changing as it comes in.

label: Aftermath & Follow-Ups
definition: Coverage after a news event has broken: outcomes, reactions, and follow-up reporting.

label: General News
definition: Headlines and stories across topics, at national, local, or regional level.

label: Top Headlines
definition: The day's most important stories across topics.

label: Local & Regional News
definition: News from a specific city, state, or region.

label: Politics & Opinion
definition: Political ideas, takes, or debates — includes ideology breakdowns, campaigns, and critiques.

label: Political Discourse
definition: Contested political and social questions and the argument around them.

label: Current Politics
definition: Covers day-to-day political news, figures, and party developments as they unfold.

label: Contested Issues
definition: Controversial political and social issues where viewpoints sharply divide.

label: Policy Analysis
definition: Breakdowns or analysis of political issues, proposals, or legislative actions.

label: Legislation & Bills
definition: Breaks down bills, laws, or political decisions with context, critique, or explainer framing.

label: Elections & Campaigns
definition: Covers candidates, campaigns, polling, and voter behavior before and after elections.

label: Conspiracy Theories
definition: Explores secretive narratives, alternate histories, or fringe theories critically or speculatively.
scope_note: Excludes ghosts and unexplained phenomena (13.39.080).

label: Government Secrets
definition: Explores declassified documents, covert programs, or conspiracy-related theories.

label: Event Mysteries
definition: Investigates unexplained public events or phenomena through timelines and theories.

label: Wars & Conflicts
definition: Analyzes or recounts war history, military conflicts, or international relations.

label: Geopolitics & International Relations
definition: Covers the alliances, rivalries, territorial disputes, and diplomacy behind current and recent conflicts.

label: Military History
definition: Narrative and analytical history of past wars, battles, and military strategy.

label: Active Conflicts
definition: Ongoing coverage of developments in an active conflict.

label: Veterans & Civilians in War
definition: Covers the lives and experiences of veterans, service members, and civilians affected by conflict.

label: Culture & Society
definition: Observations on identity, values, behavior, rituals, or subcultures within society.

label: Social Issues
definition: Content that explores social justice issues, equity, and systemic critique.
scope_note: Commentary and analysis of social issues. Excludes advocacy and calls to action (10.30).

label: Criminal Justice & Civil Rights
definition: Covers law, policing, incarceration, civil rights, and systemic inequality.

label: Underrepresented Communities
definition: Covers the lived experiences and concerns of underrepresented and marginalized communities.

label: Cultural Trends
definition: Describes cultural behaviors, rituals, changes, or subgroups within society.

label: Fashion Shifts
definition: Analyzes how fashion changes over time, across regions, or within subcultures, as cultural history rather than current styling.

label: Technology & Society
definition: Covers how emerging technologies affect behavior, work, ethics, and cultural norms.

label: 3D Modeling

label: Music Creation
definition: Behind-the-scenes or tutorial-based content showing how music is written, recorded, or produced.

label: Songwriting
definition: Shows the process of writing lyrics, melody, or full compositions for music.

label: Lyric Writing
definition: Shows how lyrics are structured, drafted, or rewritten in different musical genres.

label: Melody Crafting
definition: Breaks down how melodies are developed using voice, instrument, or digital tools.

label: Music Production
definition: Content focused on producing, mixing, or engineering music using digital tools.

label: Beat Making

label: Mixing Techniques

label: Writing & Storytelling
definition: Content centered around narrative structure, fiction, prose, and literary development.

label: Fiction Writing

label: Literature

label: Comic Lore & Character Histories

label: Webcomics & Manga
